cases.title: Verify that the language switcher does not appear in the header when disabled in the CMS

steps.action: In CMS Control Panel, navigate to Header Configuration
steps.expected: Header Configuration form accepts the Disabled setting and saves it

steps.action: Set Language Switcher = Disabled and save
Load any published page on the public website
steps.expected: Header top-right cluster renders without the AR/EN language switcher; the Accessibility and Search icons remain unaffected

cases.disposition_reason: SKIP-SPEC-GAP: HeaderConfiguration field table has no language-switcher enable/disable field; the EN/AR buttons in Object Authoring's Preview panel are a staff preview control, not this setting (confirmed with user 2026-09-30) — requirements-vs-implementation conflict per cms/Content-Admin-Guide.docx, escalated to QA Manager/BA 2026-09-30.
